blocks.zh: 反跳拦截
"让对手动弹不得的艺术" —— Aquadictus
反制手段参见跃迁核心强度

反跳（Tackling）是指将一艘舰船固定住使其无法逃脱的行为。反跳是 EVE 中 PvP 的核心机制，因为未被反跳的舰船很可能在被打爆前就跃迁脱离战斗。反跳通常使用跃迁扰频器（Warp Scrambler）和停滞缠绕光束（Stasis Webifier）等模块完成，但也有多种模块可以减缓敌舰速度或使其无法跃迁。虽然反跳通常指网子（web）和反跳模块的组合，但跃迁干扰才是区分"反跳"和单纯"减速"的关键要素。
反跳手（tackler）是指负责固定敌舰以便其他玩家将其击杀的飞行员，这个词也可以指为此目的配置的舰船。反跳船通常不配置输出（即使有也很低），但没有反跳的战列舰战斗通常以护盾被打光的一方跃迁逃跑而告终。这意味着正是反跳手促成了击杀，因此反跳手也会出现在 KM（击毁报告）上。如果双方都不被困住，一场战斗很少会以舰船被击毁而结束。
反跳手也是舰队作战的核心，舰队指挥通常会优先确保舰队反跳手的有效部署。
反跳装配
反跳模块
有多种模块设计用于阻止目标逃脱。这些模块要么阻止目标跃迁，要么减缓目标速度，要么阻止其使用微型曲跃引擎推进器（MWD）或微型跳跃引擎（MJD）。

However, in addition to stopping warping / 正在跃迁 the warp scrambler / 跃迁扰乱设备 stops the ship from usingmicro jump drives, micro jump field generators, and microwarpdrives. These propulsion modules will be disabled regardless of the ship's remaining warp core strength. This makes scramblers vital in catching certain fits.The basic / 初级 range for a warp scrambler / 跃迁扰乱设备 is significantly lower than that of a warp disruptor / 跃迁扰断器. 跃迁干扰探针. This probe / 探索级 creates a warp disruption / 跃迁干扰 bubble, with a 20km radius / 半径, that lasts for two minutes before collapsing. All ships within this field cannot activate / 激活 their warp drives to leave, however they can otherwise move freely. As the field is an area of effect warp disruption / 跃迁干扰 method this module works even if the ship is unable to target the target. The probe / 探索级 is also completely independent and will keep the bubble up even if the interdictor is destroyed, however the probes can be destroyed bysmartbombs.This module can only be used byinterdictors. This module cannot be activated in High or Low security space.See the below section onWarp disruption fieldsfor bubble mechanics / 机械学.This module has no variations, however there is a Surgical variant of the probe / 探索级 which has only a 10km radius / 半径 but lasts three minutes.The Howling Interdictors / 拦截舰操作 update on 27th October, 2020, added an additional variant of the probe / 探索级: the Stasis Webification Probe / 停滞缠绕探针, or 'Wubble'. When dropped, a Wubble will sit idle for 3 seconds, then detonate, applying a 30% speed reduction to all ships within 10km of the point where it was dropped. Unlike normal / 普通 bubbles, the Wubble probe / 探索级 will not persist after it detonates, and does not otherwise interfere with affected ships warp drives. However, Wubbles can be used in combination with normal / 普通 bubbles to hinder and disrupt an enemy fleet.

跃迁干扰 module which can only be used byheavy interdiction cruisers / 巡洋舰. The Generator can be used in three different modes: Unscripted, Focused Disruption, and Focused Scrambling. When used unscripted, the generator creates an interdiction field similar to that of an Interdiction Sphere Launcher / 发射器, but centered on the generating ship rather than an outside probe / 探索级. When unscripted, the generator cycles in 30 seconds, and while it can be kept running it cannot be deactivated early. When used scripted, the generator targets its disruption on a single ship with an insurmountable 100 points of warpcore disabling strength (leading to the nickname "Infinity Point / 定点"). When scripted, the generator cycles in only 6 seconds, but drains the ship's capacitor more quickly. Additionally, when used scripted on a hostile capital ship, it will disable / 禁用 that capital ship's ability to activate / 激活 stargates to leave the system.While a warp disruption / 跃迁干扰 field generator is active, the ship activating it suffers a 50% increase to its signature radius / 信号半径, and cannot be targeted by allied remote repairs or capacitor transmitters / 传信器.Different effects of the module:Without scripts this module forms a warp disruption / 跃迁干扰 bubble and is limited / 限时 to null / 0.0 security and wormhole space only. SeeWarp disruption fieldsfor details.With warp disruption / 跃迁干扰 script it works as a warp disruptor / 跃迁扰断器 module with increased range and infinite strength. This script greatly extends the field generator's normal / 普通 range. This script allows the module to be used anywhere. Unusually, this scriptalsowill disable / 禁用 the target's MJD or MJFG.With warp scrambling script it works as a warp scrambler / 跃迁扰乱设备 with increased range and infinite strength. Like the normal / 普通 scrambler this also stops the target from using MJD, MJFG, or MWD. This script slightly reduces the field generator's normal / 普通 range (however it is still much longer range than an ordinary scrambler). This script allows the module to be used anywhere.Different variations of this module have different ranges, however in most cases the only variants used are T2 (20km), and True Sansha (21km). This module's range is also affected by the pilot's level inHeavy Interdiction Cruisers / 巡洋舰, and the script equipped (if any).

跃迁扰断器 and the warp scrambler / 跃迁扰乱设备. The stasis webifier focuses on decreasing the sub-warp speed of a ship. The sub-warp speed is the speed that you normally fly around at.The sub-warp speed reduction depends on the version of the module. The tech 1 version causes a 50% speed reduction, the tech 2 version causes a 60% speed reduction. Both modules have a maximum range of 10km. Faction variations of this module exist, and come in varying levels of increased range and either 50%, 55%, or 60% speed reduction (up to 14km/60% or 15km/55% at most).Skill / 技能 Requirements:Navigation ICPU Management IIIPropulsion Jamming I(For theTech 1module)Propulsion Jamming / 推进阻扰理论 IV(For theTech 2module)While tackling someone, a tackler should always use a warp disruptor / 跃迁扰断器 or scrambler before the stasis webifier. Reducing the top speed of a ship with a web will make it easier for the target to warp away because they can then more quickly reach the 75% of top speed needed for initiating warp. So point first, then web.

战列舰 and capital ships, however it applies a much greater speed reduction than a normal / 普通 web. Only one stasis grappler can be fitted to a ship.Unlike a normal / 普通 web (which has a fixed 10-15km range), stasis grapplers have only 1km optimal range, but 8-12kmfalloffrange, meaning that the grappler's extremely powerful speed reduction is only fully effective at extremely close ranges, and beyond that its reduction becomes less and less effective. The chart at the top of this section shows the effectiveness of different grappler variants at different ranges. The result is that within normal / 普通 web ranges, the grappler applies a much more powerful slow; but that beyond normal / 普通 web ranges, the grappler still provides a weak slow, which makes the grappler less consistent than a normal / 普通 web but also much more flexible.Assuming the extra mid slots are available, it is common to fit a battleship with both a grappleranda web, to combine the web's reliability with the grappler's strength and flexibility, and toreallyimmobilize fast ships at close range and ensure the battleship's large guns can strike true.

跃迁扰乱设备. Similar to the stasis grappler, these modules can only be fit to Battleships / 战列舰 and above, and consume large amounts of powergrid / 能量栅格. Functionally, they work the same as the ordinary Warp Disruptors / 跃迁扰断器 and Warp Scramblers / 跃迁扰频器, but with increased range, capacitor cost, and scramble strength. The increased strengths of these modules make them useful for attempting to hold down supercapital ships, but in most other circumstances do not outweigh their high fitting and capacitor costs.A T1 Heavy Warp Disruptor / 跃迁扰断器 has a range of 22km; a T2 Heavy has a range of 26km. These modules have a warp core disabling strength of 3 points. Faction and Officer variations of this module have increased range (out to 30km and 40km at most), and increased strengths of up to 4 and 5 points.A T1 Heavy Warp Scrambler / 跃迁扰乱设备 has a range of 8.5km; a T2 Heavy has a range of 10km. These modules have a warp core disabling strength of 6 points. Faction and Officer variations of this module have increased range (out to 12.25km and 15km), and increased strengths of 8 and 10 points.Skill / 技能 Requirements:Navigation IV(For theTech 1module)Navigation V(For theTech 2module)CPU / CPU使用量 Management IIIPropulsion Jamming IV(For theTech 1module)Propulsion Jamming / 推进阻扰理论 V(For theTech 2module)

blocks.zh: 跃迁扰断力场（泡泡）
跃迁扰断力场（泡泡）是一种区域效果，阻止其中所有舰船使用跃迁引擎。该力场具有无限的跃迁扰断强度；任何数量的跃迁核心稳定器都无法让舰船从泡泡中跃迁出去，但其他移动和推进模块不受限制。跃迁扰断力场只能在零安空间和虫洞中使用。
创建跃迁扰断力场有五种方式：
专用舰船
虽然所有舰船都能成功使用反跳装备，但某些舰船有特定的船体加成使它们成为独特的反跳舰船。
所谓的"反跳护卫舰"是大多数人进入反跳的入门点。这些舰船速度快、灵活，拥有将反跳模块电容消耗降低 80% 的船体加成。通常用作初始"英雄反跳"——率先飞向敌人将其固定。
T1 反跳护卫舰的直接升级是 T2 截击舰。每种有两个变体：战斗截击舰（伤害加成）和舰队截击舰（反跳射程加成 + 可装配拦截失效装置）。截击舰还减少了 MWD 信号半径膨胀和 80% 反跳模块电容消耗。
战斗截击舰:
下一步完全改变了反跳风格。拦截驱逐舰是 T2 驱逐舰，可以创建持续两分钟的跃迁扰断泡泡。放出泡泡后拦截驱逐舰可以自由移动，即使击毁拦截驱逐舰也不会解除泡泡对受害者的困束。但飞行员放泡泡时必须小心，因为模块有中等的重装时间，而且泡泡也会阻止友方甚至飞行员自己跃迁。
重型拦截巡洋舰是拦截驱逐舰的"大哥"。这些 T2 巡洋舰凭借 T2 抗性配置和额外抗性加成拥有非常高的防御。它们的首选模块是跃迁干扰力场发生器。重型拦截舰可以随意开启泡泡（但可能无法随意关闭，因为泡泡的 30 秒循环无法提前中断）。重型拦截舰必须利用其高抗性，因为在干扰发生器激活时无法接收友方遥修。跃迁干扰力场发生器还可以配合干扰或扰频脚本使用，将模块变为无限强度的远距离长点或短点。
米玛塔尔和盖伦特电子攻击护卫舰在特定反跳模块上获得大幅加成。米玛塔尔的土狼级在电子攻击舰技能每级获得 40% 网子射程加成，而盖伦特的克勒斯级获得每级 15% 的跃迁扰断器和扰频器射程加成，以及每级 10% 的激活成本降低。
米玛塔尔和盖伦特侦察舰获得与其更小的电子攻击同门类似但更强的加成。米玛塔尔侦察舰在侦察舰技能每级获得惊人的 60% 网子射程加成，而盖伦特侦察巡洋舰获得同样可怕的每级 20% 跃迁扰断器和扰频器射程加成。
米玛塔尔和盖伦特战略巡洋舰的电子战子系统专门用于反跳，虽然加成弱于侦察舰，但可以与战略巡洋舰的其他战斗能力叠加使用。洛基级的固定驱动器在米玛塔尔核心系统技能每级给予 25% 网子射程加成和 10% 网子过载加成，海神级的摩擦延伸处理器每级给予 7.5% 跃迁扰断器和扰频器射程加成和 15% 过载加成。
除了 T2 和 T3 舰船外，还有各种具有反跳相关加成的海盗势力舰船。
莫德团系列舰船每级相关盖伦特舰船技能获得 10% 的跃迁扰断/扰频器射程加成。虽然很少用作舰队反跳，但延伸射程允许在敌方有效范围外作战的同时将其留在网格上。
蛇蜥系列舰船每级相关米玛塔尔舰船技能获得 10% 的停滞缠绕光束效果加成。5 级时 T2 网子可将目标减速 90%。
血袭者盟约系列每级获得 20% 网子射程加成。但这些舰船很少因网子加成而使用，其能量中和加成更为显著。

zh: 铁骑舰载机操控理论, afterburners (or ABs) can be fitted to ships in EVE Online. The afterburner / 加力燃烧器原理 increases your sub-warp speed by a percentage. Afterburners are often used while in orbit around a target to help evade enemy fire and keep the user's ship alive. However, in the face of microwarpdrives, they are often not fast enough to leap into battle on their own and catch enemies who are not yet in range.The Tech 1 module boosts your speed by 115% (thus it doubles your speed plus another 15%). The Tech 2 version boosts your speed by 135%. Faction and Deadspace variations of this module offer further speed boosts (of 140-160%), but are much more expensive and thus not commonly used.
1 加力燃烧器原理 ITech 2:Afterburner / 加力燃烧器原理 IV

微型跃迁推进器 (or MWD) is a small warpdrive capable of giving a significant speed boost to your sub-warp speed. It's an upgraded version of the Afterburner / 加力燃烧器原理 , however it comes with several drawbacks. Unlike an Afterburner / 加力燃烧器原理 , a Microwarpdrive / 微型跃迁推进器 is extremely effective at getting into, or out of, an enemy's range, but is not at all effective at helping evade enemy fire. An active MWD grants a 500% boost to sub-warp speed, but also increases the ship's Signature Radius / 信号半径 by 500%, making it far easier to hit than its speed would imply. Also, as mentioned above, Microwarpdrive / 微型跃迁推进器 s are forcibly de Activate / 激活 d by hostile Warp Scrambler / 跃迁扰乱设备 s . MWDs also consume more capacitor to operate, and having an MWD fitted to a ship reduces the ships maximum capacitor capacity (and thus, indirectly, the ship's capacitor regeneration rate). As a result of all this, it is often best to use an MWD to get into tackle range of a target, and then de Activate / 激活 it while in close orbit to avoid being hit.The Tech 1 module gives a 500% Bonus / 加成 to speed, at the cost of 500% increased Signature Radius / 信号半径 and 25% reduced capacitor capacity. The Tech 2 module gives a 510% boost to speed, but only 20% reduced capacitor capacity. However, The Use / 使用 of Tech 2 MWDs is often frowned upon, in favor of the Quad LiF Restrained variant, which gives a 505% Bonus / 加成 to speed, 20% reduced capacitor capacity, only 450% increased Signature Radius / 信号半径 (mitigating a little of the evasion problem), and lower capacitor consumption than the Tech 2 variant.Faction and Deadspace Microwarpdrive / 微型跃迁推进器 s are popular on more expensive ships, as while they do not offer great improvements to speed, they offer greatly reduced capacitor capacity and Signature Radius / 信号半径 penalties. They are, however, very expensive and thus not worth using unless youknowyou won't lose them.
1 高速机动理论 ITech 2:High Speed Maneuvering / 高速机动理论 IV
感应增强器(with Scan Resolution Script / 扫描分辨率修正脚本)

锁定 on the target you want to tackle. Every ship has a certain scan resolution, visible in the fitting window, which, together with your target's signature radius / 信号半径, determines the time it takes to lock / 锁定 a target. With a sensor booster / 感应增强器 you can increase that scan resolution which enables you to decrease the lock / 锁定-time and so point or scram the target faster.The tech 1 version of the sensor booster / 感应增强器 boosts your scan resolution by 25%, while the tech 2 version boosts it by 30%. Sensor Boosters / 感应增强器 also increase your maximum targeting range, but that's less relevant to tackling. If you put a scan resolution script / 扫描分辨率修正脚本 in the sensor booster / 感应增强器 (which you should in most cases, as the range will not be necessary), the scan resolution bonus / 加成 doubles and the bonus / 加成 to targeting range disappears. So you can get a 50% scan resolution bonus / 加成 from the tech 1 booster and a 60% from the tech 2 version.

These modules provide slightly greater bonuses than regular sensor boosters / 感应增强器, but can only be used on allies (and not on yourself) and thus must be prepared and coordinated in advance.These modules are commonly seen in Gate Camps, to ensure that the campers catch their targets.

超速驱动装置 Injector System

重要的 in order to reach your target quickly. The faster you can get into targeting and warp disruption / 跃迁干扰 range, the faster you can tackle the target. The nice thing about overdrive / 超速驱动装置 injector systems is that they don't require powergrid / 能量栅格 or CPU / CPU使用量. The downside of the overdrive / 超速驱动装置 injector system is that your cargohold m³ will decrease. As a tackler you do not use your cargohold, so you can ignore that penalty.The sub-warp speed increase of the tech 1 overdrive / 超速驱动装置 injector system is 10.4% (with a cargohold penalty of 15%), and the tech 2 module gives a 12.5% increase speed (and a 20% cargohold penalty).
机械学 ITech 1:Hull Upgrades / 船体加固理论 ITech 2:Hull Upgrades / 船体加固理论 II

超速驱动装置 injector, however, it also makes your ship more agile. Using this module will help you accelerate and align faster, allowing you to reach targets faster, and allow you to keep a closer orbit at a higher speed, making you harder to track and thus harder to kill. Like overdrives, nanos don't require any powergrid / 能量栅格 or CPU / CPU使用量. The downside of this module is that you get a lower amount of structure hit points (HP / 结构值). In a way this downside doesn't matter though, because, generally speaking, tackling frigates / 护卫舰 tend to either be able to rely on their shields / 护盾, armor, and speed for long enough to either be saved by the logi or pull range and escape, or if their armor doesn't hold up and they do enter structure they're pretty much dead anyway.The sub-warp speed increase from the tech 1 module is 7.84%, with a 13.1% inertia reduction, at the cost of 15% structure HP / 结构值. The tech 2 module increases sub-warp speed by 9.4%, cuts inertia by 15.8%, and reduces structure HP / 结构值 by 20%.
机械学 ITech 1:Hull Upgrades / 船体加固理论 ITech 2:Hull Upgrades / 船体加固理论 II

Polycarbon Engine Housing rigs give a 5.5% bonus / 加成 to sub-warp speed, and 9.1% reduction to inertia, akin to a weaker Nanofiber. Both rigs come at the cost of 10% Armor HP / 结构值. These rigs can be useful if there are not enough low slots to fit an Overdrive / 超速驱动装置 or Nanofiber, but more speed is required. However, these rigs are not ideal on ships which rely on armor for their defense.

It will also make you much more resistant to smartbombs and drones, two major threats to tacklers / 截停者.The tech 1 module increases shield, armour and hull resistances by 7.5%, 10% and 50% respectively; the tech 2 module increases them by 12.5%, 15% and 60% respectively.

护盾扩展装置 is a great way to significantly increase the hitpoints of your tackler without slowing you down. While high speed will reduce the damage that you take, it will only reduce it - fitting modules to increase your HP / 结构值 will keep you alive and able to tackle for much longer.While a small shield extender will be easier to fit, a medium extender provides far more HP / 结构值 and is generally preferred. You may need to use a Micro Auxiliary Power Core in order to provide the powergrid / 能量栅格 to fit one. A Tech 1 medium shield extender / 护盾扩展装置 gives you an additional 750 base shield hitpoints (most frigates / 护卫舰 have between 350 and 500 shield hitpoints to begin with, so that's a huge difference). A Tech 2 medium shield extender / 护盾扩展装置 increases your base shield hitpoints by a huge 1050 HP / 结构值!
1 护盾提升 ITech 2:Shield Upgrades / 护盾提升 IV(Optional)Capacitor Management / 电容管理学 II(to fit a Micro Auxiliary Power Core)

战斗战列巡洋舰, Command Destroyers / 指挥驱逐舰操作, Command Ships / 指挥舰操作, and specially fit Strategic Cruisers / 战略巡洋舰, which when active improve the combat capabilities ofallnearby ships in their fleet. Shield and Armor Command Bursts / 爆发级 can help a tackler by making them more durable, but the most useful bursts / 爆发级 are Skirmish Command Bursts / 爆发级; as they can improve a tackle ship's flight speed, increase acceleration and decrease signature radius / 信号半径, and increase the range of warp disruptors / 跃迁扰断器, scramblers, and stasis webifiers.

跃迁扰频器还是跃迁扰断器？
任何反跳手的首要任务是确保目标不逃跑。最重要的是阻止敌方跃迁，可用跃迁扰断器或扰频器实现。每种模块各有优缺点，有效舰队会两者兼备。
跃迁扰断器（长点）射程是扰频器的两倍多（T1 20km，T2 24km），允许反跳手保持更远距离。扰断器非常耗电容，通常用于初始反跳，别人上短点后应关闭。在 T2 截击舰上特别受欢迎。
跃迁扰频器（短点）射程短得多（7.5-9km），但不仅阻止跃迁还关闭 MWD。由于几乎所有大于护卫舰的舰船都用 MWD，扰频器会显著减慢它们。因此任何舰队都必须有扰频器。扰频器电容消耗远低于扰断器可无限期运行。
使用扰频器使反跳手非常接近立体炸弹范围（5km/T2 6km）。对可能装备立体炸弹的目标（如低安战列舰）需小心，建议设置 6-7.5km 轨道。
如果反跳手同时装了扰断器和扰频器，可用"飞掠扰频"战术：大部分时间在扰频范围外用扰断器，关键时刻冲进去上短点关闭 MWD/MJD，然后飞回安全距离。
加力燃烧器还是微型曲跃引擎推进器？
乍一看 AB 和 MWD 功能相同——都增速，MWD 更多。但像 EVE 中很多事情一样，没那么简单。
MWD 有严重缺点：激活时信号半径增加 500%，更易被命中；非常耗电容无法长期运行；被扰频器时会被强制关闭。MWD 仅用于接近目标，到达后应关闭。
加力燃烧器不增加信号半径，电容消耗少，可在轨道飞行时保持开启。能降低敌方炮台命中率和导弹伤害。
总结：MWD 快速进入射程但到达后风险高；AB 进入较慢但到达后更安全。
大多数情况建议装 MWD。但 MWD 操作比 AB 更不容错。第一次 PvP 可考虑 AB。
可以在一艘舰船上同时装配加力燃烧器和 MWD（称为"双推进"），前提是有足够的中槽位以及 CPU 和 PG——这在一些 T2 和势力舰船上很流行，但在大多数 T1 护卫舰上很难做到，不推荐新手使用。
T2 截击舰（以及在较小程度上 T2 突击护卫舰）获得 MWD 加成，减少信号半径惩罚。因此它们在战斗中使用 MWD 时受到的伤害大大减少。远程"舰队"截击舰通常会在整场战斗中保持 MWD 开启。
什么类型的防御？
反跳和推进模块之后，最重要的是防御——抓住目标却被轻易击杀毫无意义。
你有时会看到人们给反跳护卫舰全装速度模块不装防御。这种配装最常见的地方是击毁报告上——被它们试图反跳的目标成群击杀。速度很重要，但反跳护卫舰已经足够快来追上游戏中大部分舰船（特别是使用 MWD 时），进一步提升速度不是首要任务。
无论如何都应装损伤控制。大幅增加有效生命值且几乎没有缺点。
之后，反跳手有两个选择——盾抗或甲抗。盾抗通常是反跳手的最佳选择，前提是有足够的中槽位（至少需要三个——推进、反跳和防御各一个）。这是因为盾抗不会减慢反跳手速度。理想的护卫舰反跳盾抗是单个中型护盾扩展器。
如果无法装盾抗，甲抗也是一种选择。装甲板会减速，但额外 HP 加上装甲抗性模块可以产生很大差别。200mm 加强钢板通常是最佳选择。甲抗更适合使用扰频器和/或网子的近距离反跳手，因为这些配置不太依赖速度来生存。
大多数时候，反跳手需要缓冲坦克（HP 和抗性模块）而非主动坦克（甲修或盾提）。因为小型甲修或盾提的修复速度通常不足以抵消被玩家攻击时受到的伤害——使用缓冲坦克通常能存活更久。
除了实际生命值外，反跳护卫舰的高速度也能减少受到的伤害。即使在专业 T2 截击舰上也不能完全消除伤害，但结合一些防御模块应该能让你活得更久。如果装完防御后还有低槽或改装位剩余，用加速模块填充是个好主意。
简单的 PvP 指导：注意扰频器会关闭 MWD，首先决定你计划的作战距离。近距离作战时扰频器性价比高但要预期被反扰频失去 MWD，考虑选择加力燃烧器。远距离作战时可以用扰断器配 MWD，但注意不要太近被扰频关闭 MWD。
是否装配停滞缠绕光束？
网子能显著降低目标速度，射程略长于扰频器。装了扰频器就应装网子。如果目标装了 AB，扰频器不够，需要网子才能留住。
如果反跳手装的是扰断器，决定就不那么明确。首先需要决定是否要在网子射程内飞行。尽管有远距离扰断器，反跳手通常尽可能近距离轨道更难被击中，可能仍然想在网子范围内飞行。如果是这样，装网子很有意义。另一方面，反跳手可能想留在网子范围外——因为他们驾驶全程开 MWD 的 T2 截击舰，或想避开目标的网子和能量中和器。这种情况下装网子没什么意义，中槽不如装其他模块（如感应增强器或跟踪扰断器）。
是否装配感应增强器？
感应增强器提高扫描分辨率以更快锁定目标。装了扰断器时有意义，但不应优先于防御模块。
远程还是近程武器？
大多数情况应装短程武器。近距离配装装远程武器无意义；远距离配装仍需短程武器对付无人机。
给远程反跳手装短程武器的问题是会忍不住靠近主要目标来输出伤害。大多数时候可能没事，但最终会因此送命——进入了立体炸弹、网子等模块的范围。所以确保按预期使用模块和武器。
远程武器只有在反跳手需要从远距离击中目标时才有意义。在常规舰队中，T1 反跳护卫舰的伤害通常很小，不应该是优先事项；反跳手的首要关注是反跳目标并保持存活。
对于很多护卫舰来说，即使舰船没有射弹炮台加成，使用射弹武器（自动加农炮或火炮）也是合理的。射弹武器不消耗电容，自动加农炮的 CPU 和 PG 需求也很低。混合炮和激光武器只有在舰船提供合理的伤害、射程或跟踪加成时才有意义。
反跳配装中还有另一种理念：一些反跳船完全不装武器，既节省配装空间（留给防御），又省去了思考武器激活、弹药和有效射程的过程。
使用无人机
一些 T1 护卫舰至少可以使用一架小型无人机，应该利用这一点。不使用无人机舱基本等于不使用船上的一个槽位。简单的战斗无人机如霍布高布林或战士就可以。
能量吸取装置
一些攻击护卫舰有一个由于缺少挂载点而无法装武器的多用途高槽。如果预期敌人装有能量中和模块，能量吸取装置可以作为吸取电容能量维持扰断器的手段。
T1 还是 T2 模块？
使用 T2 模块会提高反跳手的性能，但需要更好的技能且贵得多，对于某些模块在 T1 护卫舰上可能不值得。
记住所有模块都有所谓的"改良"版本，性能高于原版 T1 并有一个或多个其他特定加成。改良模块通常非常便宜，在大多数情况下应尽可能替代 T1 模块使用。
T2 跃迁扰断器比任何 T1 版本多 4 公里射程，只需额外一级推进干扰技能，对远程反跳手非常有用。T2 损伤控制也明显优于 T1 版本。
是否装配电子战模块？
空闲中槽装电子战模块能倍增舰船对舰队的价值。跟踪扰断器或感应抑制器即使无加成也非常有效。
大多数用于反跳的 T1 护卫舰不提供特定类型电子战的加成。然而，跟踪扰断器和远程感应抑制器在任何舰船上都非常有效，即使没有加成。ECM 干扰模块是唯一的例外，不推荐在没有 ECM 加成的舰船上使用。
反跳相关技能
这些技能都非必需——没有它们仍可成为出色反跳手——但会让工作更轻松。建议训练到 IV 级。
